ITEM.PTXT: Shift control sets the target input shaft speed based on information such as accelerator opening, vehicle speed and brake signal so that the optimum gear ratio and shift speed are obtained. Furthermore, a signal is output to the shift control duty solenoid (DS1,DS2) so that the speed obtained from the primary pulley speed sensor matches the target input shaft speed, optimizing the gear ratio.
In the D position, control is performed through integrated engine control to maximize fuel economy and driving performance.
